source: Sellés et al. 2021, Scientific Reports 11, Figure 3: Panel A of a time-calibrated troodontid tree with shaded subfamily boxes and geographic colour bars; 27 tips. The root is a 3-way node (Geminiraptor, Hesperornithoides, rest); Troodontinae has a 4-way node. Matrix spellings from the Hartman et al. matrix: IGM1001128, IGM100140, IGM10044, Troodon_sensu_lato, Urbacodon_mandibular_only. Image: embedded image at native resolution, unmodified (2008x1461 px). Gold tree and name list from the Open Paleo corpus session (2026-10-29).
